DocsInstallAPI

Configuration Reference

This reference page describes every option the tool accepts. It is written the way documentation sites write: a short intro, then sections with code the reader is expected to copy, and it is long enough to clear the extraction threshold used by the local pipeline.

Installing

Install the package with your usual package manager, then import it:

npm install pi-webaio --save

The import looks like this, where fetchPage is the entry point:

import { fetchPage } from "pi-webaio/webfetch";
const page = await fetchPage("https://example.com");
console.log(page.content);

Options

Options are passed as an object and each one is optional:

  1. format — output format, defaults to markdown
  2. budgetTokens — hard ceiling on returned size

Nested heading

A third-level heading under Options, included because heading depth is one of the shape properties that a converter bump can silently flatten.

Back to body text after the nested heading so the structure alternates the way real documentation pages alternate it.
